title: Imperial Stormtrooper
caption: Stormtrooper (V)
heading: Imperial Stormtrooper (V)
game_text_lines:
Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free
on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster
Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose
one (may take the other into hand). Immune to
Rebel Barrier.
lore: One of countless elite shock troops totally loyal to the Emperor. Unquestioningly follow orders. Willing to sacrifice their lives to accomplish a mission. First-strike forces.

notes: COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1100) on the dark-blue Imperial character frame. Title bar: Imperial disc (blue Imperial crest) at the left, title 'Imperial Stormtrooper' (no dot), destiny 3 (printed 1). Lore box printed with the same lore as the Premiere card (first line indented; 3 lines) → lore = printed lore, no base_lore needed; matches the wiki and the scan. Right of the lore box: ONLY an EPISODE I disc (Premiere prints no ring) → ring_icons ['episode1'] (added by the slip). Art window BLANK white → base scan art. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4 (printed POWER 1 / ABILITY 1 / empty third box); deploy 2 / forfeit 3 (printed 1 / 2). Icon column: warrior (blue box with a rifle-holding hand, as printed); then the diamond-17 mark (no set sphere). Caption 'Stormtrooper (V)' names the base card; stub title 'Imperial Stormtrooper (V)'. Game text replaced (printed: 'Deploys free to same site as one of your Imperials with ability > 2.'); slip text matches the stub. Base: Premiere Limited 'Stormtrooper' (Premiere-D-stormtrooper.gif, 350 px; copyright 1995 legible on the scan's vertical line). Modern: VB4-D-imperialstormtrooper-pre.gif (350, same Premiere art).
